name: package-manifest-update
body: The release workflow regenerates the Homebrew formula (`Formula/kalide.rb`) and Scoop manifest (`bucket/kalide.json`) in their public forms — the formula with plain release-download `url` + `sha256` per macOS arch (no custom download strategy), the Scoop manifest with a standard `architecture` block (`64bit`, and `arm64` only when released) of `url` + `hash`, and no token `pre_install` — for the new version, `kalide-<os>-<arch>` asset URLs and SHA-256 checksums, and pushes them as a manifest-only commit to really-knows-ai/kalide (the one CI push the humans-push-and-tag constraint allows). AC: after a release, both files reference the new version and their checksums match the published assets; the generated files contain no download-strategy reference, no `pre_install`, and no `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`/`KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`; the CI commit touches only files under `Formula/` and `bucket/`; CI creates no tags.
